note: Fall's first comfortable weekend: bayou cruises, arboretum trails and a citywide lemonade showdown.

picks.reason: Lemonade Day's citywide best-tasting contest — kids' lemonade stands judged head to head.
Buffalo Bayou Cruise gets the family on the water while it is finally cool enough to enjoy it.

Free outdoor music and culture at Garver Park with The Rhythm of Our Roots.
Baile Folklorico workshop — a Hispanic Heritage Month dance class families do together.
Free Sunday morning yoga on the Arboretum lawn.
Tyke Hikes en espanol — a bilingual Sunday nature walk sized for small legs.
